<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="Carl Gomes — 11-year-old wingfoil athlete from Florida. Team rider profile, competition results, progression and contact links.">
<title>Carl Gomes | Wingfoil Athlete</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#151d24; --muted:#64717c; --gold:#c69717; --gold2:#e4c46d;
    --paper:#fff; --soft:#f6f7f7; --line:#dfe3e5; --blue:#61728b;
    --max:1160px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.45}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
  a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold2);outline-offset:4px}
  .wrap{width:min(var(--max),calc(100% - 36px));margin:auto}
  .topbar{padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20}
  .topbar .row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}
  .brand{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,30px)}
  .brand .fam{color:var(--gold)}
  .nav{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
  .nav a{font-weight:750;font-size:14px;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:999px}
  .nav a:hover{background:var(--soft)}
  .nav .phone{border:1px solid var(--line)}

  .hero{padding:34px 0 18px}
  .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:30px;align-items:stretch}
  .hero-photo{min-height:560px;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:#ddd}
  .hero-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:48% 38%;display:block}
  .hero-photo:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:45%;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(8,16,24,.76));pointer-events:none}
  .hero-caption{position:absolute;left:28px;bottom:24px;color:white;z-index:2}
  .hero-caption .eyebrow{font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.24em;font-weight:800;opacity:.9}
  .hero-caption h1{font-size:clamp(46px,7vw,86px);line-height:.92;margin:8px 0 5px;letter-spacing:-.045em}
  .hero-caption h1 span{color:#e6bc42}
  .hero-caption .sub{font-size:clamp(15px,2vw,22px);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.13em;font-weight:800}

  .intro{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#fbfbf8)}
  .present{font-weight:800;font-size:18px;color:var(--muted)}
  .name{font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(46px,5.4vw,74px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:14px 0 8px}
  .name span{color:var(--gold)}
  .handle{font-size:24px;font-weight:850;margin-bottom:8px}
  .tag{color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:18px}
  .brush{font-family:"Segoe Print","Bradley Hand",cursive;font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,62px);font-style:italic;color:var(--blue);transform:rotate(-4deg);margin:38px 0 26px;line-height:1.05}
  .goldstroke{width:140px;height:5px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:99px;transform:rotate(-3deg);margin-top:10px}
  .quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:30px}
  .quick a,.quick div{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;font-weight:800;background:white}
  .quick small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px}
  .quick a:hover{border-color:#c9b15e;box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}

  .stats{padding:18px 0 40px}
  .stats .inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden}
  .stat{padding:20px;text-align:center;background:#fff}
  .stat+.stat{border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
  .stat b{display:block;font-size:28px}
  .stat span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:850}

  .section{padding:34px 0}
  .section h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,50px);line-height:1;margin:0 0 22px;letter-spacing:-.025em}
  .section h2:after{content:"";display:block;width:58px;height:4px;background:var(--gold);margin-top:12px;border-radius:4px}
  .lead{font-size:20px;color:#34414b;max-width:850px}
  .two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px}
  .card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;background:#fff}
  .card h3{font-size:26px;margin:0 0 18px}
  .results{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
  .results li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:76px 1fr;gap:16px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .results li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
  .year{color:var(--gold);font-weight:950}
  .results b{display:block;font-size:18px}
  .results span{color:var(--muted)}

  .progress{display:grid;gap:12px}
  .progress div{padding:16px 18px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:14px;border-left:4px solid var(--gold)}
  .progress strong{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;margin-bottom:4px}

  .story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:34px;align-items:center}
  .story img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 46%;border-radius:20px;display:block}
  blockquote{margin:0;font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,38px);font-weight:720;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em}
  blockquote:before{content:"“";color:var(--gold);font-size:90px;line-height:.4;display:block;margin-bottom:18px}
  .why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:26px}
  .why div{background:var(--soft);padding:15px 16px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:750}

  .setup{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:15px}
  .setup a{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:25px;border-radius:16px;text-align:center;font-weight:950;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.02em;transition:.15s ease}
  .setup a:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .independent{color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 20px;font-weight:700}


  .family-gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:120px;gap:14px}
  .family-gallery a{display:block;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
  .family-gallery img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .25s ease,filter .25s ease}
  .family-gallery a:hover img{transform:scale(1.025);filter:saturate(1.05)}
  .family-gallery a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold2);outline-offset:3px}
  .family-gallery .g1{grid-column:span 4;grid-row:span 4}
  .family-gallery .g2{grid-column:span 4;grid-row:span 4}
  .family-gallery .g3{grid-column:span 4;grid-row:span 4}
  .family-gallery .g4{grid-column:span 6;grid-row:span 3}
  .family-gallery .g5{grid-column:span 3;grid-row:span 3}
  .family-gallery .g6{grid-column:span 3;grid-row:span 3}
  .family-gallery .g1 img{object-position:50% 44%}
  .family-gallery .g2 img{object-position:50% 44%}
  .family-gallery .g3 img{object-position:50% 46%}
  .family-gallery .g4 img{object-position:50% 48%}
  .family-gallery .g5 img{object-position:50% 50%}
  .family-gallery .g6 img{object-position:50% 52%}
  .gallery-note{margin:-8px 0 22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:17px}

  .travel{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;min-height:400px;margin:20px 0 50px}
  .travel img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 56%}
  .travel:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(10,20,28,.75),rgba(10,20,28,.05) 64%)}
  .travel-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;color:#fff;padding:42px;width:min(600px,85%)}
  .travel-copy h2{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,64px);margin:0 0 14px;line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.04em}
  .travel-copy p{font-size:18px;max-width:500px}
  .travel-copy .line{width:100px;height:5px;background:#e4bc46;border-radius:99px;margin-top:18px}

  .cta{padding:35px 0 70px}
  .cta-box{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:32px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:24px;align-items:center;background:#fcfcfa}
  .cta h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:36px}
  .cta p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:17px}
  .buttons{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
  .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:13px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:850;background:#fff}
  .btn.primary{background:var(--ink);color:white;border-color:var(--ink)}
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
  svg.icon{width:18px;height:18px;fill:currentColor;flex:0 0 auto}
  footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 0 36px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}

  @media (max-width:820px){
    .hero-grid,.two,.story,.cta-box{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .hero-photo{min-height:520px}
    .stats .inner{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
    .stat:nth-child(3){border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
    .stat:nth-child(4){border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
    .setup{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .family-gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:210px}
    .family-gallery .g1,.family-gallery .g2,.family-gallery .g3,.family-gallery .g4,.family-gallery .g5,.family-gallery .g6{grid-column:span 1;grid-row:span 1}
    .nav a:not(.phone){display:none}
    .buttons{justify-content:flex-start}
  }
  @media (max-width:520px){
    .wrap{width:min(var(--max),calc(100% - 24px))}
    .hero{padding-top:18px}.intro{padding:24px}.quick{grid-template-columns:1fr}.why{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .results li{grid-template-columns:60px 1fr}.hero-photo{min-height:450px}
    .family-gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-auto-rows:auto}
    .family-gallery a{aspect-ratio:4/3}
  }
  @media print{
    .topbar{position:static}.nav{display:none}.hero{padding-top:10px}body{background:#fff}.card,.intro,.cta-box{box-shadow:none}
    a{text-decoration:none}.travel{break-inside:avoid}.section{break-inside:avoid}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="topbar">
  <div class="wrap row">
    <a class="brand" href="#top" aria-label="GoFamExplore home">Go<span class="fam">Fam</span>Explore</a>
    <nav class="nav" aria-label="Profile navigation">
      <a href="#profile">Profile</a><a href="#results">Results</a><a href="#team">Team</a><a href="#setup">Setup</a><a href="#family">Family</a>
      <a class="phone" href="tel:+16465522940">☎ 646-552-2940</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top">
<section class="hero">
  <div class="wrap hero-grid">
    <div class="hero-photo">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Carl Gomes airborne while wingfoiling">
      <div class="hero-caption">
        <div class="eyebrow">11-Year-Old Wingfoil Athlete</div>
        <h1>CARL <span>GOMES</span></h1>
        <div class="sub">Freestyle · Big Air · Adventure</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <aside class="intro">
      <div>
        <div class="present">@gofamexplore Presents:</div>
        <div class="name">Carl <span>Gomes</span></div>
        <a class="handle" href="https://www.instagram.com/carlfoiling/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">@carlfoiling ↗</a>
        <div class="tag">Florida, USA · Independent Rider</div>
        <div class="brush">Follow the wind.<div class="goldstroke"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="quick">
        <a href="https://www.instagram.com/carlfoiling/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><small>Carl on Instagram</small>@carlfoiling ↗</a>
        <a href="https://www.instagram.com/gofamexplore/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><small>Family / Brand Contact</small>@gofamexplore ↗</a>
        <a href="tel:+16465522940"><small>Phone</small>646-552-2940</a>
        <div><small>Home</small>Florida, USA</div>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="stats">
  <div class="wrap inner">
    <div class="stat"><b>11</b><span>Age</span></div>
    <div class="stat"><b>2 Years</b><span>Wingfoiling</span></div>
    <div class="stat"><b>3 Wins</b><span>2026 Event Wins</span></div>
    <div class="stat"><b>USA</b><span>Nationality</span></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="profile">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>About Carl</h2>
    <p class="lead">Carl Gomes is an 11-year-old wingfoiler from Florida, USA. After only two years in the sport, he has already grown from a first-time competitor into a multiple-event winner. Backed by a family that follows the wind, Carl travels to ride, train and compete while sharing the adventure along the way.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="results">
  <div class="wrap two">
    <div class="card">
      <h3>Competition Highlights</h3>
      <ul class="results">
        <li><span class="year">2026</span><div><b>Cortez Crown</b><span>Amateur Winner</span></div></li>
        <li><span class="year">2026</span><div><b>Bridge of the Gods</b><span>Amateur Winner</span></div></li>
        <li><span class="year">2026</span><div><b>Baja Big Air</b><span>Wing Category Winner</span></div></li>
        <li><span class="year">2026</span><div><b>Lighthouse 1000</b><span>Downwinder Participant</span></div></li>
        <li><span class="year">2025</span><div><b>Grom Fest</b><span>First Competition</span></div></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <h3>Skills &amp; Progression</h3>
      <div class="progress">
        <div><strong>Currently landing</strong>Palaus, Raleys and 360s</div>
        <div><strong>Working on</strong>720s and backflips</div>
        <div><strong>Next goal</strong>Land a 720 and backflip at Grom Fest 2026</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="team">
  <div class="wrap story">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Carl wingfoiling with a yellow wing">
    <div>
      <h2>Why Carl Wants to Join a Team</h2>
      <blockquote>I want to be part of a team to share stories, learn from older riders, grow the sport and inspire other riders.</blockquote>
      <div class="why">
        <div>Authentic family adventure story</div>
        <div>Youth inspiration and progression</div>
        <div>Social content and brand visibility</div>
        <div>Event participation and representation</div>
        <div>Dedicated family support</div>
        <div>Travels to ride, train and compete</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="setup">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Current Setup</h2>
    <p class="independent">Independent rider currently using Armstrong, Duotone and Slingshot equipment.</p>
    <div class="setup">
      <a href="https://armstrongfoils.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">ARMSTRONG ↗</a>
      <a href="https://www.duotonesports.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">DUOTONE ↗</a>
      <a href="https://slingshotsports.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SLINGSHOT ↗</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="wrap travel" aria-label="Family travel and support">
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="GoFamExplore family expedition truck on the beach">
  <div class="travel-copy">
    <h2>Backed by a family that follows the wind.</h2>
    <p>Family support makes it possible for Carl to train in different conditions, attend key events and experience the wingfoil community in new places.</p>
    <div class="line"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="family">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Family Adventures</h2>
    <p class="gallery-note">More moments from life on the water and on the trail.</p>
    <div class="family-gallery">
      <a class="g1" href="data:image/jpeg;base64," target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open photo 1 full size"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Wingfoiling action photo" loading="lazy"></a>
      <a class="g2" href="data:image/jpeg;base64," target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open photo 2 full size"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Young wingfoiler on the water" loading="lazy"></a>
      <a class="g3" href="data:image/jpeg;base64," target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open photo 3 full size"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Foil rider with a parawing" loading="lazy"></a>
      <a class="g4" href="data:image/jpeg;base64," target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open photo 4 full size"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Mountain biking on a rocky forest trail" loading="lazy"></a>
      <a class="g5" href="data:image/jpeg;base64," target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open photo 5 full size"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Wingfoiler carrying a green wing" loading="lazy"></a>
      <a class="g6" href="data:image/jpeg;base64," target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open photo 6 full size"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Wingfoiler on the water with a green wing" loading="lazy"></a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="cta">
  <div class="wrap cta-box">
    <div><h2>Team rider / ambassador opportunities</h2><p>For brand partnerships, event opportunities and social collaboration, contact the family directly.</p></div>
    <div class="buttons">
      <a class="btn primary" href="https://www.instagram.com/carlfoiling/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 2h10a5 5 0 0 1 5 5v10a5 5 0 0 1-5 5H7a5 5 0 0 1-5-5V7a5 5 0 0 1 5-5Zm0 2a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v10a3 3 0 0 0 3 3h10a3 3 0 0 0 3-3V7a3 3 0 0 0-3-3H7Zm5 3.5A4.5 4.5 0 1 1 7.5 12 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 12 7.5Zm0 2A2.5 2.5 0 1 0 14.5 12 2.5 2.5 0 0 0 12 9.5Zm5.25-3.1a1.05 1.05 0 1 1-1.05 1.05 1.05 1.05 0 0 1 1.05-1.05Z"/></svg>
        @carlfoiling
      </a>
      <a class="btn" href="https://www.instagram.com/gofamexplore/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 2h10a5 5 0 0 1 5 5v10a5 5 0 0 1-5 5H7a5 5 0 0 1-5-5V7a5 5 0 0 1 5-5Zm0 2a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v10a3 3 0 0 0 3 3h10a3 3 0 0 0 3-3V7a3 3 0 0 0-3-3H7Zm5 3.5A4.5 4.5 0 1 1 7.5 12 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 12 7.5Zm0 2A2.5 2.5 0 1 0 14.5 12 2.5 2.5 0 0 0 12 9.5Zm5.25-3.1a1.05 1.05 0 1 1-1.05 1.05 1.05 1.05 0 0 1 1.05-1.05Z"/></svg>
        @gofamexplore
      </a>
      <a class="btn" href="tel:+16465522940">☎ 646-552-2940</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

<footer><div class="wrap">© GoFamExplore · Carl Gomes Wingfoil Athlete Profile</div></footer>
</body>
</html>
